key: HEATHER: Hey, stay back!
en: HEATHER: Hey, stay back!
ja: ヘザー: ちょっと、下がってて!

key: HEATHER: Shh!
en: HEATHER: Shh!
ja: ヘザー: しっ!

key: Look!
en: Look!
ja: 見て!

key: HEATHER: That was close!
en: HEATHER: That was close!
ja: ヘザー: 危なかった!

key: You gotta be more careful!
en: You gotta be more careful!
ja: もっと気をつけてよね!

key: They've got a Pokémon hooked up to some kind of big machine in there!
en: They've got a Pokémon hooked up to some kind of big machine in there!
ja: 中でポケモンが何か大きな機械につながれてる!

key: Whatever it is, it can't be good!
en: Whatever it is, it can't be good!
ja: 何であれ、ロクなもんじゃないわ!

key: Let's sneak around the area and take out their guards before they notice anything's up!
en: Let's sneak around the area and take out their guards before they notice anything's up!
ja: 気づかれる前に、こっそりまわりの見張りを片づけましょ!

key: Take this to help!
en: Take this to help!
ja: これ、役に立つから持ってて!

key: HEATHER: I stole it from one of them, but don't worry about that!
en: HEATHER: I stole it from one of them, but don't worry about that!
ja: ヘザー: 連中の一人から盗んだんだけど、気にしないで!

key: Let's kick their butts good!
en: Let's kick their butts good!
ja: こてんぱんにしてやりましょ!

key: An Egg seems to have been abandoned here.
en: An Egg seems to have been abandoned here.
ja: タマゴが置き去りにされているようだ。

key: Take it?
en: Take it?
ja: 持っていく?

key: \PN got the Egg!
en: \PN got the Egg!
ja: \PNはタマゴを手に入れた!

key: Just a little kid lost in the woods? No, you're something else.
en: Just a little kid lost in the woods? No, you're something else.
ja: 森で迷っただけの子供? いや、お前は何か違うな。

key: Something else entirely.
en: Something else entirely.
ja: まったく別のものよ

key: If I really wanted, I could snare you here and now. Be glad that our boss hasn't given any such orders.
en: If I really wanted, I could snare you here and now. Be glad that our boss hasn't given any such orders.
ja: 本気を出せば、この場で捕らえることだってできる。ボスから何も命令が出ていないことに感謝することね。

key: You again! Coming to take what's ours once more!?
en: You again! Coming to take what's ours once more!?
ja: またお前か! 今度もあたしたちのものを奪いに来たのね!?

key: One day...
en: One day...
ja: いつか、きっと……

key: At least you're not gonna blow anything up this time... Right?
en: At least you're not gonna blow anything up this time... Right?
ja: まあ、今回は何も爆破しないんでしょうね……よね?

key: Hold it right there!
en: Hold it right there!
ja: 待ちなさい!

key: Ugh...
en: Ugh...
ja: うぐっ……

key: Why can't I just win for once?
en: Why can't I just win for once?
ja: どうして一度も勝てないんだ?

key: A familiar face. Time for familiar vengeance.
en: A familiar face. Time for familiar vengeance.
ja: 見覚えのある顔だ。おなじみの仕返しの時間だな。

key: Familiar defeat.
en: Familiar defeat.
ja: 見慣れた敗北だ

key: Next time it won't be so easy.
en: Next time it won't be so easy.
ja: 次はこう簡単にはいかないぞ。

key: HEATHER: I've got most of the others taken care of.
en: HEATHER: I've got most of the others taken care of.
ja: ヘザー: 他の連中はほとんど片づけたわ。

key: Here, let me heal you up.
en: Here, let me heal you up.
ja: ほら、回復してあげる。

key: HEATHER: Anyway, time to charge in there.
en: HEATHER: Anyway, time to charge in there.
ja: ヘザー: とにかく、あそこに突入する時間よ。

key: This tower looks like it could be a good jungle-gym for you.
en: This tower looks like it could be a good jungle-gym for you.
ja: このタワー、あんたにはちょうどいいジャングルジムに見えるわね。

key: I see a way in.
en: I see a way in.
ja: 入り口が見えるわ。

key: You do too, right?
en: You do too, right?
ja: あんたにも見えるでしょ?

key: "Jasper Ward Gym"
en: "Jasper Ward Gym"
ja: 「ジャスパー区ジム」

key: HEATHER: ...Wait, that's it?
en: HEATHER: ...Wait, that's it?
ja: ヘザー: ……待って、これで終わり?

key: It didn't collapse?
en: It didn't collapse?
ja: 崩れなかったの?

key: But the enemy base is always supposed to collapse after you beat the bad guys!
en: But the enemy base is always supposed to collapse after you beat the bad guys!
ja: 悪者をやっつけたら、悪の基地って崩れるものじゃないの!?

key: This is a rip!
en: This is a rip!
ja: 詐欺じゃない!

key: HEATHER: Well, whatever.
en: HEATHER: Well, whatever.
ja: ヘザー: まあ、いっか。

key: We made a pretty good team!
en: We made a pretty good team!
ja: あたしたち、いいコンビだったじゃない!

key: And did you see me?! Those grunts were easy- peasy.
en: And did you see me?! Those grunts were easy- peasy.
ja: それに、あたしのこと見てた?! あのしたっぱたち、楽勝すぎ。

key: I swear, half the time it took to beat them was just waiting for their Pokémon to finish falling over!
en: I swear, half the time it took to beat them was just waiting for their Pokémon to finish falling over!
ja: ほんと、倒す時間の半分はあいつらのポケモンが倒れきるのを待ってただけよ!

key: What kind of challenge is that?!
en: What kind of challenge is that?!
ja: あれのどこが試練なわけ?!

key: COREY: HEATHER!
en: COREY: HEATHER!
ja: コーリー: ヘザー!

key: HEATHER: ...Uh-oh.
en: HEATHER: ...Uh-oh.
ja: ヘザー: ……やばっ。

key: COREY: Heather, what in the wretched world are you doing here?!
en: COREY: Heather, what in the wretched world are you doing here?!
ja: コーリー: ヘザー、いったいこんなところで何をしているんだ?!

key: I've been looking for you everywhere!
en: I've been looking for you everywhere!
ja: あちこち探し回ったんだぞ!

key: Do you have any idea how worried I've been?
en: Do you have any idea how worried I've been?
ja: どれだけ心配したかわかっているのか?

key: HEATHER: I have a pretty good idea, yeah.
en: HEATHER: I have a pretty good idea, yeah.
ja: ヘザー: そりゃもう、よーくわかってるわよ。

key: COREY: What in the blazes were you thinking, running off like that?!
en: COREY: What in the blazes were you thinking, running off like that?!
ja: コーリー: いったい何を考えて、あんな風に飛び出したんだ?!

key: Have I not made it perfectly clear time and time again how utterly unsafe it is for you to be running about on your own!?
en: Have I not made it perfectly clear time and time again how utterly unsafe it is for you to be running about on your own!?
ja: お前が一人で出歩くのがどれほど危険か、何度も言い聞かせてきたはずだろう!?

key: A girl at your age--
en: A girl at your age--
ja: お前くらいの年頃の娘が――

key: Even your mother wasn't--
en: Even your mother wasn't--
ja: お前の母さんですら――

key: You're... carrying her ring around again.
en: You're... carrying her ring around again.
ja: ……また、母さんの指輪を身につけているのか。

key: HEATHER: No, dad, why don't you go ahead and finish that sentence?
en: HEATHER: No, dad, why don't you go ahead and finish that sentence?
ja: ヘザー: いいから、パパ、その続きを言ってみなさいよ。

key: My mother wasn't WHAT?
en: My mother wasn't WHAT?
ja: あたしの母さんが、何?

key: Do you wanna actually talk about that?
en: Do you wanna actually talk about that?
ja: 本当にその話、したいわけ?

key: COREY: ...Please, Heather, not right now-- not here.
en: COREY: ...Please, Heather, not right now-- not here.
ja: コーリー: ……頼む、ヘザー、今はやめてくれ――ここではだめだ。

key: HEATHER: Then WHEN, huh?!
en: HEATHER: Then WHEN, huh?!
ja: ヘザー: じゃあ、いつなのよ?!

key: You ALWAYS refuse to tell me ANYTHING about her!
en: You ALWAYS refuse to tell me ANYTHING about her!
ja: パパはいつだって、母さんのこと何にも話してくれないじゃない!

key: Or why this STUPID ring is the only thing she left behind?!
en: Or why this STUPID ring is the only thing she left behind?!
ja: このバカみたいな指輪だけが、母さんの残した唯一のものなのに、どうしてなのよ?!

key: If you cared about her so much, why are you so afraid of talking about her?!
en: If you cared about her so much, why are you so afraid of talking about her?!
ja: 母さんのことをそんなに大事に思ってるなら、どうしてそんなに話すのを怖がるの?!

key: COREY: ENOUGH!
en: COREY: ENOUGH!
ja: コーリー: いい加減にしろ!

key: You are untimely in pressing far too hard into matters which you do not and cannot comprehend!
en: You are untimely in pressing far too hard into matters which you do not and cannot comprehend!
ja: お前には理解できない、理解のできようもない事柄に、あまりにも軽率に踏み込みすぎている!

key: I have done all that I do for the sake of keeping you safe--
en: I have done all that I do for the sake of keeping you safe--
ja: 私がしてきたことはすべて、お前の安全を守るためだ――

key: HEATHER: And you won't even tell me what from?!
en: HEATHER: And you won't even tell me what from?!
ja: ヘザー: それなのに、何から守ってるのかすら教えてくれないじゃない?!

key: I don't NEED your protection-- just ask \PN!
en: I don't NEED your protection-- just ask \PN!
ja: パパの保護なんかいらない――\PNに聞いてみてよ!

key: I just took out three bad guys without breaking a sweat!
en: I just took out three bad guys without breaking a sweat!
ja: あたし、汗ひとつかかずに悪者を三人も倒したんだから!

key: I think you just wanna keep me caged up!
en: I think you just wanna keep me caged up!
ja: パパはただ、あたしを閉じ込めておきたいだけなんじゃないの!

key: COREY: ...I beg your pardon, you did what?
en: COREY: ...I beg your pardon, you did what?
ja: コーリー: ……すまないが、何をしたと言ったんだ?

key: HEATHER: Three of the evil people in black hoods, in the time it took \PN to beat one!
en: HEATHER: Three of the evil people in black hoods, in the time it took \PN to beat one!
ja: ヘザー: 黒いフードの悪者を三人、\PNが一人倒す間にね!

key: So think about that!
en: So think about that!
ja: だから、よく考えてみてよ!

key: COREY: Did they see the ring?
en: COREY: Did they see the ring?
ja: コーリー: 指輪は見られたのか?

key: HEATHER: What?
en: HEATHER: What?
ja: ヘザー: 何?

key: COREY: Your mother's ring-- did they or did they not see it?!
en: COREY: Your mother's ring-- did they or did they not see it?!
ja: コーリー: お前の母さんの指輪だ――見られたのか、見られていないのか?!

key: HEATHER: What the heck are you talking about?!
en: HEATHER: What the heck are you talking about?!
ja: ヘザー: いったい何の話をしてるのよ?!

key: Actually, you know what?
en: Actually, you know what?
ja: ……というか、もういい。

key: Forget it.
en: Forget it.
ja: 忘れて。

key: I'm sick of you always yelling at me over stupid things.
en: I'm sick of you always yelling at me over stupid things.
ja: パパがいつもくだらないことで怒鳴ってくるの、もううんざり。

key: Salamence, let's get out of here!
en: Salamence, let's get out of here!
ja: ボーマンダ、ここから出るわよ!

key: COREY: Heather, wait--
en: COREY: Heather, wait--
ja: コーリー: ヘザー、待て――

key: COREY: Leave this place.
en: COREY: Leave this place.
ja: コーリー: この場を去れ。

key: Do not speak to me or my daughter ever again.
en: Do not speak to me or my daughter ever again.
ja: 二度と私や娘に話しかけるな。

key: This is non-negotiable.
en: This is non-negotiable.
ja: これは交渉の余地がない。

key: Am I clearly understood?
en: Am I clearly understood?
ja: わかったな?

key: COREY: Good.
en: COREY: Good.
ja: コーリー: よろしい。

key: COREY: Then clean out your ears.
en: COREY: Then clean out your ears.
ja: コーリー: では、耳をよく洗っておくことだ。

key: You are unwanted here.
en: You are unwanted here.
ja: お前はここでは歓迎されていない。

key: Be gone.
en: Be gone.
ja: 去れ。

key: \PN obtained PULSE Read-out 05B!
en: \PN obtained PULSE Read-out 05B!
ja: \PNはPULSE解析データ05Bを手に入れた!

key: PULSE Dex updated!
en: PULSE Dex updated!
ja: PULSE図鑑が更新された!

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
